name: Necromancers
overview: Scripture clearly condemns necromancy and consulting those with familiar spirits, warning God's people not to seek guidance from wizards or those who claim to communicate with the dead. Leviticus 19:31 and Isaiah 8:19 emphasize that believers should turn to God rather than the occult, highlighting the futility and spiritual danger of seeking the dead. Acts 19:19 demonstrates the transformative power of the gospel as those involved in such practices renounced and destroyed their occult materials, signifying a break from spiritual defilement toward holiness.
